title: Profile lifecycle on Android: Java <-> native bridge
description: Same init/storage/deletion path as the desktop ProfileImpl walkthrough, but crossing into Java. On Android, ProfileManager::UnloadProfile() is disabled (#if !IS_ANDROID), so the Java-visible Profile wrapper is instead created/destroyed alongside the native Profile object itself.

title: ProfileImpl lifecycle: init, storage, deletion
description: Where a ProfileImpl instance is created, where ProfileManager keeps ownership of it, and where it gets destroyed.
